hooks.command: bash -lc 'cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && [ -d .venv ] || (python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt); [ -f shroom.db ] || .venv/bin/python -m backend.app.seed >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "Shroom OS env ready (./run.sh to start, .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -q to test)"'
